# Tobias R.M.K. Meyer

> Embedded engineer in Munich. Senior Embedded AI Engineer at Hula Earth (since June 2026), building self-sufficient bioacoustic IoT sensors. Ten years of low-power firmware, radio protocols and device development, including engineering management of a railway sensor device team. Also offers technical advisory for embedded and IoT products.

This file is generated by `generate.py` from `templates/llms.txt`. The site is static HTML; all pages are available in English and German (German via an in-page language switch on the main pages, separate URLs on the blog).

## About

- Name: Tobias Raphael Maria Karl Meyer (T.R.M.K. Meyer)
- Based in: Munich, Germany
- Current role: Senior Embedded AI Engineer at Hula Earth (Jun 2026 – present). Owns the BIoT (bioacoustic IoT) device development: firmware, power, connectivity and certification; coordinates supplier, product and team.
- Previous: KONUX, railway infrastructure IIoT (Sep 2020 – May 2026): Senior Firmware Developer, then Engineering Manager of the Device Team (Jul 2025 – May 2026).
- Previous: EnOcean, energy-harvesting radio (Jan 2010 – Aug 2020): intern, then Software Engineer.
- Education: B.Sc. Electrical Engineering (2010–2013), M.Sc. Computer Science (2013–2015).
- Languages: German (native), English (fluent).
- Core skills: C, C++, Python, Zephyr RTOS, ultra-low-power design, BLE, LTE-M, NB-IoT, LoRa, Zigbee, Thread, EnOcean, firmware architecture, CE/RED and FCC certification, Edge AI / TinyML, engineering management.
- Outside work: climbing and alpinism, road cycling, mostly vegan cooking, travel photography.
